thread:
alex: Heads-up — after the kernel-selector change rolled yesterday, I grabbed a quick perf capture. SM activity looks low but VRAM and page faults spike on the long-context route /chat/stream. heatmap attached: https://grafana.redwood/../d/sm-heatmap (shortlink)

michael: ugh. Is that the selector fallback to the generic kernel?

alex: looks like it. Selector is choosing generic path for batches >512 tokens. that path keeps larger kvcache footprints, causing more VRAM churn and MIG slice pageins.

infra-bot: deploy @alex deployed commit 4e9b2d -> prod/us-west (2026-03-17T21:04:00Z) :rocket:

tess: hypothesis: prefetching + larger kernel -> double-alloc behaviour. prefetch warms KV for predicted seq offsets, but generic kernel uses non-quantized layouts so GPU memory jumps. Can repro with synthetic long seq workload.

alex: repro steps? want to capture SM occupancy + per-token latency aligned to KV cache events.

tess: run this quick capture on a dev slice: `./tools/profile --routes /chat/stream --window 30s --metrics sm_active,sm_idle,vram_used,kv_prefetch_hits,kv_prefetch_misses --output /tmp/prefetch-capture.json`

sara: also add `--gpu-trace` and collect `nvml` logs for power/thermal. last time thermal throttling made the tail latency worse.

nathan: can we pivot kernel selector to prefer the compact kernel for these routes while we investigate? toggle flag `selector.force_compact=true` for canary pool?

alex: good call. I'm going to canary that on pool r-02 for 10 mins. will also enable `profiling.token_breakdown` to get token-level latency buckets.

michael: for dashboards — proposal: new per-route panel with following series: `p50/p95/p99 token_latency`, `sm_active_pct`, `vram_util_mb`, `kv_prefetch_rate`, `mig_slice_util_pct`, `gpu_power_w`, `thermal_c`. aggregate window = 5s, retention 14d for high-res.

tess: add a histogram of token latency by prefix length (0-64,64-256,256-1024,>1024). that'll show cost cliff when kvcache misses + fallback kernel hit.

sara: alert rules idea: fire when `p99_token_latency` > 1200ms AND `vram_util_mb` increased >20% vs baseline for 2 consecutive 1m windows. also alert on `mig_slice_pagein_rate` > 5/min.

nathan: capture from canary so we can compare before/after selector flag. alex post the capture link here when done.

alex: canary toggle on r-02 now, running synthetic at t+2m. starting perf capture. will paste short traces.

infra-bot: canary update: selector.force_compact=true applied to r-02 (10 instances) by @alex (2026-03-17T21:12:00Z).

alex: quick interim result: SM active jumped from 42% -> 78% on r-02, VRAM dropped ~18% on same workload, p99 token latency improved from 1.9s -> 0.9s. early win.

michael: nice. looks like compact kernel + prefetch tuning avoids big VRAM footprint.

tess: next steps: 1) adjust prefetch window to 3 tokens ahead for long-context routes, 2) make selector prefer compact for seq>512 until we improve generic path memory layout, 3) add the token-latency-by-prefix histogram to perf dashboard.

sara: i'll draft the alert rules and add runbook steps for `selector.rollback` and `kvcache.flush` commands.

nathan: i'll open a short-lived experiment PR to flip selector.default_threshold from 512 -> 768 and include telemetry to watch `kernel_choice` label per-route.

alex: assigned tasks: @nathan PR, @sara alerts+runbook, @tess prefetch tweak + capture. i'll keep canary on for 30m then scale if stable. thanks all :thumbsup:

michael: can we also schedule a microprofiler session tomorrow to instrument kernel memory alloc paths? quick 30m sync.

alex: yes — 10:00am PT tomorrow. calendar invite sent.
